**Glancy** adds thumbnails to Windows File Explorer for 87 formats (265 extensions): design files (PSD, AI, EPS,
PDF, SVG, InDesign, CorelDRAW, Affinity…), camera RAW, HDR, game textures, 3D and CAD, documents, e-books and more,
with a settings app for Windows 11 in seven languages. Free and open source (GPL-3.0-or-later).

**Install:** download `GlancySetup-<version>.exe` below and run it. It installs for your user account without
administrator rights (Windows 10 2004 or later, x64) and makes Glancy File Explorer's thumbnail provider for the file
types it supports; uninstalling from Settings › Apps restores the previous providers.

[Code signing policy](https://github.com/sergiocespedesp/glancy/blob/main/docs/code-signing-policy.md) · Glancy sends
no data over the network (no telemetry, no update checks).
